You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important were the Battles of Verdun and the Somme to the outcome of the war? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was US intervention in the war as a reason for Germany’s defeat in 1918? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
3 How important was propaganda as a reason for increased support for the Nazis between 1930 and
1932? Explain your answer. [40]
4 How significant was the German Labour Front (DAF) in increasing Nazi control after 1933? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
5 How important was the impact of war on the civilian population as a reason for the collapse of
Tsarist rule in Russia in March 1917? Explain your answer. [40]
6 How significant was the need to rapidly modernise Soviet industry as a reason for the introduction
of the Five-Year Plans? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
7 How important was the availability of credit as a cause of economic growth in the USA in the 1920s?
Explain your answer. [40]
8 How significant a consequence of the Depression was the Bonus March? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were Mao’s agricultural policies to the modernisation of China by 1960? Explain
your answer. [40]
10 How significant was the Hundred Flowers campaign in consolidating Communist Party rule in
China? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
11 How important were the racial policies of the National Party as a reason for its electoral success
in 1948? Explain your answer. [40]
12 How significant was the use of government censorship to the maintenance of white minority rule
in South Africa between 1966 and 1980? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
13 How important was Ben Gurion in the creation of the state of Israel? Explain your answer. [40]
14 How significant was the United Nations in the Arab–Israeli conflicts to 1973? Explain your
answer. [40]
